card.fires_on: The period inside a section number such as 2.2 or 5.1, and the word "see" or "Warning" in bracketed cross-references like [see Dosage and Administration (2.2)]. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.description: The decimal point after the main section digit in numbered label sections or cross-references.
